author: Brian Wilson
releaseNotes: Fixes "Install / update dashboard UI" writing a mix of two builds when run shortly after a release (GitHub's raw-file cache can serve some files fresh and others stale). The installer now downloads the whole set, verifies it is one build, and only then writes - and writes nothing if the source is inconsistent. If your dashboard reports "mixed builds", update the app and click Install / update dashboard UI again.
